mutations.label: RBE the announcement test is INVERTED, so a run that announced it could not measure is read as a finding of zero and a run that said nothing is read as unmeasured -- precisely backwards. Both strings survive; only behaviour flips.

RBF the sentence is no longer passed at the #1202zb call site, so the disambiguation is dead and every absent artifact falls back to the old ambiguous UNMEASURED. The helper still SUPPORTS it, so a source-text assertion mentioning `unmeasured_says` still reads as coverage.

RBG the needle becomes the TICKET ID instead of the emitted sentence. A lane grepping for the id puts the id in the log -- the sibling marker `SEED SHORTFALL` has 12 such lines across 9 runs, every one a search and not a sighting -- so this would read a lane's search as the probe failing to measure.
